comment: The CTRL knob is a single control with two jobs: right of centre it locks the loop by keeping the old bit, left of centre it doubles the loop length, and in the centre every new bit is random. The TRIG output has no family because Trig Output type changes what it carries between a pulse, a gate and a clock-width pulse. The Copy and Paste clipboard and the .tss sequence file are shared with the trigSeq modules.
